desc: Ideation: choose first-entry subtraction (full total minus start-inside and left/bottom first-entry edges)
Implement factorial/inv-factorial precomputation up to W+H+5 and O(1) binomial C(n,k)
Implement full_total and O(1) start_inside rectangle sum via T(A,B)
Implement left_entry and bottom_entry edge sums with boundary skips and modulo normalization
Run sample tests 1-3 and small brute-force cross-checks for W,H<=5, including L=0, D=0, R=W, U=H, and single-allowed-point cases
Finalize code; performance acceptable with O(W+H) precomputation and edge sums
